statements.select: SELECT COMPANY_CD AS DEPT_CD , COMP_NM AS DEPT_NM FROM T_COMPANY where USE_YN = 'Y' order by dept_cd
SELECT COMPANY_CD, DEPT_CD, DEPT_NM FROM T_DEPARTMENT where company_cd = #COMPANY_CD# and dept_level = '2' and USE_YN = 'Y' order by dept_cd
SELECT COMPANY_CD, DEPT_CD, DEPT_NM FROM T_DEPARTMENT where company_cd = #COMPANY_CD# and UP_DEPT_CD = #UP_DEPT_CD# and dept_level = '3' and USE_YN = 'Y' order by dept_cd
SELECT COMPANY_CD, DEPT_CD, DEPT_NM FROM T_DEPARTMENT where company_cd = #COMPANY_CD# and UP_DEPT_CD = #UP_DEPT_CD# and dept_level = '4' and USE_YN = 'Y' order by dept_cd
SELECT COMPANY_CD, DEPT_CD, DEPT_NM FROM T_DEPARTMENT where company_cd = #COMPANY_CD# and dept_level = '3' and sadept_yn = 'Y' order by dept_cd
SELECT COMPANY_CD, DEPT_CD, DEPT_NM FROM T_DEPARTMENT where company_cd = #COMPANY_CD# and UP_DEPT_CD = #UP_DEPT_CD# and sadept_yn = 'Y' and DEPT_CD not in ('D_ROOT') order by dept_cd

SELECT a.USER_CD, a.USER_NM, a.dept_cd, b.up_dept_cd FROM T_USER a inner join T_DEPARTMENT b on a.dept_cd = b.dept_cd WHERE a.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND a.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND b.up_dept_cd = #up_dept_cd#
AND a.DEPT_CD = #dept_cd#
ORDER BY a.USER_NM ASC

SELECT USER_CD,USER_NM FROM T_USER WHERE COMPANY_CD != 'YONWOO' AND USE_YN = 'Y'
AND DSTR_CHN = #dstr_chn#
ORDER BY USER_NM ASC
SELECT NAT_CD , case when #language# = 'KOR' then NAT_NM when #language# = 'ENG' then NAT_ENG_NM else NAT_NM end as NAT_NM , NAT_ORDER FROM T_NATION WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY NAT_NM

SELECT CODE_ID , ISNULL(case when #language# = 'ENG' then NULLIF(CODE_ENG,'') when #language# = 'CHN' then NULLIF(CODE_CHN,'') when #language# = 'JPN' then NULLIF(CODE_JPN,'') when #language# = 'KOR' then NULLIF(CODE_KOR,'') else CODE_KOR end,CODE_KOR) as CODE_NM FROM T_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND USE_YN ='Y' AND UP_CODE_ID = #UP_CODE_ID#
AND VALUE_1 = #value_1#
AND VALUE_2 = #value_2#
AND VALUE_3 = #value_3#
AND VALUE_4 = #value_4#
AND VALUE_5 = #value_5#
AND VALUE_5 != 'SM'
AND VALUE_5 NOT IN ('RQ','SM')
AND VALUE_5 NOT IN ('RQ','RV','SM')
AND VALUE_5 NOT IN ('RQ','RV','SM')
AND (VALUE_1 = 'ALL' OR VALUE_2 = #step#)
order by code_order

SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_LEVEL1 as NAME1 ,ITEM_LEVEL1 as CODE1
,ITEM_LEVEL2 as NAME2 ,ITEM_LEVEL2 as CODE2
,ITEM_LEVEL3 as NAME3 ,ITEM_LEVEL3 as CODE3
FROM T_ITEM WHERE ITEM_LEVEL1 IS NOT NULL
AND ITEM_LEVEL1 = #item_level1#
AND ITEM_LEVEL2 = #item_level2#
ORDER BY ITEM_LEVEL1 ASC
, ITEM_LEVEL2 ASC
, ITEM_LEVEL3 ASC

SELECT BASE_ITEM , (CASE WHEN #language# = 'KOR' THEN TARGET_KOR WHEN #language# = 'ENG' THEN TARGET_ENG ELSE TARGET_KOR END) AS LANG_CODE FROM T_LANGUAGE WHERE 1=1 AND BASE_ITEM != ''
AND BASE_ITEM = #base_item#
